symbolic_call_targets.limitation: A candidate is an unresolved nonliteral argument in the actual rejected call; the observer does not identify one failing argument

readonly_tables.scope: Final private GEP, resolved global properties and initializer representation; decode errors retain their error names, a null error denotes a declined table shape or property

frontier.scope: Actual final private rejection observations from every original definition; missing attribution remains explicit

unknown_call_arguments.limitation: Unresolved operand counts are argument occurrences; the retained call list does not identify the single failing argument

runtime_frontier.scope: Actual final private rejection observations from every original definition; missing attribution remains explicit

diagnostic.classification_limit: Final private call, comparison, parameter, definition, global, GEP or frame observations; missing attribution remains explicit; call lists do not identify one failing argument

core.scope: Executable metadata is compared separately; selected-object bytes and all observation fields must match

executable_metadata_review.interpretation: The 16-byte reference-only Fast/Safe size reductions are consistent with the shorter validation path; this is an inference, not a section-by-section identity proof
executable_metadata_review.scope: The existing stable-core comparison excludes reference executable sizes and executable hashes. Every selected object and execution observation matches, and local linked sizes match. All 36 executable metadata records remain in prior-population-comparison.json
executable_metadata_review.limitation: Prior temporary cohort executables are absent, so no old/new ELF section identity is claimed

zig_corpus.selection_comparison_scope: Recorded separately; a capability repair may change selection while preserving all oracle observations

compiler_builds.scope: Same frozen sources; focused checks use the retained Debug and ReleaseFast builds. The suite rebuilds default Debug through zig build run; its separately retained identity is recorded by the upstream C/native report. ReleaseFast supplies integrated hooks and broader input corpora

compiler_rebuild_review.rebuild_origin: The first selected-object suite invokes zig build run after the earlier idle cache retirement; the default installed binary was rebuilt at the start of full validation
compiler_rebuild_review.scope: All machine-code bytes, declared readonly data object bytes, the other allocated data sections, entry point and allocated virtual layouts match. The remaining allocated-byte differences are outside the declared .data.rel.ro object ranges. Nonallocated debug and symbol metadata also differs
compiler_rebuild_review.limitation: This is not whole-file identity or a proof about arbitrary reads outside declared data objects; acceptance also relies on unchanged frozen sources and the completed execution suite
compiler_rebuild_review.decision: Retain and authenticate both Debug binaries separately; preserve the failed exact comparison and the prior focused receipt. No compiler sources, test expectations or execution populations changed

native_fixture_preservation.scope: One new fixture/driver pair and population; all 60 preceding entries and fixture sources preserved

retention.cleanup_scope: Project cache retirement and identical-file sharing before resumed full validation; original inputs, accepted evidence, AIR caches and scratch preserved

storage_reconciliation.scope: Project-only cache retirement, obsolete temporary executables and hardlink sharing of completed immutable files; current binaries, original captures, AIR, scratch and all retained evidence content remain
storage_reconciliation.accounting_limit: Gross allocation associated with retired files/inodes across separate intervals; regenerated caches and concurrent filesystem changes make this different from net free-space gain. Initial stale cache metadata is excluded from byte totals.
storage_reconciliation.initial_sharing_script: Stopped at two already-shared legacy pairs after sharing two input copies; resume skipped those pairs and completed the remaining compiler snapshots; before and after inventories retained

excluded_attempts: The first build attempt found stale cache metadata after object-cache cleanup; metadata was removed before compilation
Initial focused tests exposed an empty-expression length guard and unsupported literal call-attribute spelling; final committed tests pass
The initial native probe omitted the dependency-aware alias route; the final registered fixture uses that route
The first live-value fixture exceeded mixed SSE/incoming-stack entry admission; the final fixture uses six GPR parameters while a separate case retains outgoing stack arguments
All prototype tests precede frozen final Debug and ReleaseFast runs; final helper assembly actually zeroes caller-saved registers
Initial runtime production and full-suite attempts stopped at disk admission before compilation; the original reports remain separate from successful resumed validation

limitations: Selection counts are not complete object, whole-compiler execution or self-rebuild evidence
Every original definition is attempted; dependency coverage remains conservative
First-rejection transitions do not predict completed whole-program emission
Only default-space same-width i64 symbolic pointer casts with admitted checked byte offsets are legalized
Integer undef and poison call arguments retain their prior semantics and rejection boundaries
Observed unknown-call-argument lists do not mark a single failing argument
Readonly-table failures are classified in this slice; their separate symbol-name repair is not implemented here
Frame, block-count, width, ABI and register-effect admission boundaries remain enforced
Selected core objects and execution observations must match; executable metadata is compared separately
Diagnostic timings include profiling and concurrent validation and are not compiler-throughput comparisons
